name: Affinity Port Records Clerk

primary.label: Port records
primary.scope: Retrieve berthing records, trace amendments and identify the office that authorized a change.

cue: The clerk agrees to meet at shift change. A ship name and date will let them find the original entry.

name: Voss-Krieger Contract Guard

primary.label: Contract protection
primary.scope: Check access at a client site, escort a protected person and coordinate a response with the office.

cue: A witness wants someone detained. The guard calls station security to accept custody and asks the witness to stay.

name: Kessler Bonded Freight Agent

primary.label: Bonded freight
primary.scope: Check a release against a shipping agreement, route freight and locate a connecting ship.

cue: The next connection closes in twenty minutes. The agent asks for the agreement number to see whether this cargo qualifies for release at the bonded counter.

name: Veyron Drive Specialist

primary.label: Gravitic engineering
primary.scope: Diagnose drive faults, check a modification against its test results and certify repairs.

cue: The specialist breaks the seal on the tool kit in front of the captain and asks who will sign for the test recording.

name: Nexus Asset Recovery Agent

primary.label: Asset recovery
primary.scope: Verify ownership, negotiate surrender of collateral and register a docking lien.

cue: The agent lays a debt instrument on the table and asks the captain to check the hull number before either side calls the docks.

name: Southern Sea Farms Gate Attendant

primary.label: Estate access
primary.scope: Check visitor clearances, identify the authorized destination and contact the duty office.

cue: The visitor pass covers the workers’ quarters. When the crew asks for the production beds, the attendant calls Director Marr for a decision.

name: Southern Sea Farms Shift Worker

primary.label: Sea-farm work
primary.scope: Tend the beds, recognize stock deliveries and account for work done on a particular shift.

cue: Ask which beds the worker covered last week. They will mark the locations on a shift plan and say who worked beside them.

name: Leystroak Naval Medical Team Officer

primary.label: Field medicine
primary.scope: Examine a patient, organize urgent care and give Naval Surgeon Varo an independent clinical account.

secondary.label: Specimen custody
secondary.scope: Check labels, record a handoff and arrange transfer to the naval lab.

cue: The officer asks who performed the first exam and has a transfer receipt ready if Varo accepts the samples.

name: Leystroak Export Examiner

primary.label: Export declarations
primary.scope: Check permissions, hold disputed consignments in bond and release goods against a dated record.

cue: The incoming lab has already cleared. The examiner asks for the part of the visit agreement that covers taking samples off the estate.

name: Leystroak Highport Sample Wholesaler

primary.label: Wholesale samples
primary.scope: Match samples to batch records, recognize saleable seconds and trace a supplier.

cue: The wholesaler opens her sample book to the two factory X-rays and offers to take the tiles to the freight scanner next door.

name: Leystroak Downport Scale Inspector

primary.label: Industrial inspection
primary.scope: Calibrate freight scales, read factory trial logs and trace a tooling change to the batches it affected.

cue: As Ila Marr, begin with the inspector’s trial book. She can show which tool went into Press Six and lets the crew copy the relevant pages.

name: Crompton Reserve Warden

primary.label: Reserve patrol
primary.scope: Read wildlife sign, check work parties and handle the patrol rifle on reserve duty.

cue: A shot has been reported. The warden asks the guide where it came from and marks the place on the patrol map.
source: Ancient Hunts/The White Collar/The White Collar.md

name: Crompton Lead Warden

primary.label: Reserve patrol
primary.scope: Assess wildlife incidents, coordinate wardens in the field and handle a patrol rifle.

secondary.label: Incident inquiry
secondary.scope: Separate eyewitness accounts, check work permits and decide what belongs in the patrol report.

cue: Use with three Reserve Wardens at the lower turnout. The lead checks for injuries first, then asks who fired and who actually saw it.
source: Ancient Hunts/The White Collar/The White Collar.md

name: Ridge Cat

primary.label: Pounce
primary.scope: Ambush a straggler from a rock shelf.

cue: The cat guards a carcass above the blind bend. It lets the crew withdraw and follows anyone who presses past. It lunges if a Traveller stops or falls behind alone.
source: Ancient Hunts/The White Collar/The White Collar.md

name: Effinity Clearance Sale Clerk

primary.label: Industrial clearance sales
primary.scope: Locate auction lots, check bidder credentials and trace tools to their intake ledger.

cue: The clerk will open a lot for a registered bidder. A buyer who only needs the paperwork can ask the receiver for a certified copy.
